new().Summary: $overrides (optional): {severity; retryable} to override the code defaults.

invalidateVectors().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Calls invalidateVectors() on every definition and merges the results.Returns {updated: Integer; skipped: Integer; errors: Collection of Text}

find().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns the saved Definition for the given dataclass/vector, or Null.

load().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Reads the settings file, if any, and populates This.definitions with Definition objects.Also loads This.batchSize and This.phrase (allow* options).Any unknown top-level keys (e.g. "models") are preserved internally and restored on save.

findAll().Summary: Returns the saved Definitions for the given dataclass

save().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Serializes This.definitions, batchSize and phrase options back to the settings file,preserving any other top-level keys, and merging the definitions with whatever the fileholds now (another editor may have written to it since this instance loaded).Returns False, without touching the file, when the settings could not be read at loadtime — saving then would replace real settings with defaults.

toObject().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Returns a plain object suitable for JSON persistence.The phrase is flattened to its template text.

invalidateVectors().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Nullifies the vector field (and sets the companion _dirty flag when present) for everyentity in the definition's dataclass, forcing a full re-embedding on the next run.Returns {updated: Integer; skipped: Integer; errors: Collection of Text}

validate().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Validates the definition against the live ds model and known models from settings.Returns {success: Boolean, errors: Collection of {field, message}}$settings may be Null — phrase validation will run without options.

restore().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Rehydrates the last-run info from persistence after a restart (this state is in-memoryonly, so it is empty on a fresh process). Without it, interval "lastExecution" firesimmediately and daily double-fires today's slot after every restart, and status() wouldreport "never run". $lastRun is LOCAL ISO (the scheduler's time base), not the log's UTC.No-op once an in-session run has set lastRun, so a live run is never clobbered.

endBatch().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Marks the current batch as finished with the given result and updates lastRun.

beginBatch().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Marks a batch as started. Returns False if one is already running (guards double-run).

arm().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Marks the scheduler as armed and records the anchor time for "start from now".

menuItemCount().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Builds a menu with $builder (called with the menu as $1) and returns its item count.The menu is released, never displayed.

note().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Records a value seen inside the window, for assertions once it is closed.

run().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Opens the window with $open, plays $steps inside it, and returns once it is closed.Returns False when the window could not be driven (e.g. it was already open).

invalidateDone().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Called back (CALL FORM) by _invalidateVectorsInBackground once the vectors are invalidated.

flushPromptInvalidate().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Asks about every definition changed since the last question (one dialog per item, at most).The accepted invalidations run in the "EmbeddingStudio_invalidate" worker (one save perentity: a large table would freeze the window), which calls invalidateDone() back.$then (called with $param), e.g. a compute, runs in the "EmbeddingStudio" worker oncethe invalidations queued before it are done.

selectFirstItem().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Selects the first vector of the list, if any, so the details panel is shown at startup.

openHelp().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Opens the online documentation (developer.4d.com) in the default browser (footer help button).

isEmpty().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===True while the structure holds no vector attribute and no saved definition.

paintEmptyState().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===There is nothing to configure until a 4D.Vector attribute exists: the list, the detailsand the scheduler footer are then replaced by a short "how to get started" message.

paintSchedulerStatus().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Footer status bar: repaints the one-line scheduler summary and the running spinner.

schedulerManager().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Context menu behind the footer gear button: configure + quick runtime actions.

get hasFatal().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===True when at least one fatal error was recorded (e.g. a model became unavailable).

retryableErrors().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Errors flagged retryable — re-running the operation could plausibly succeed.

get success().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===True when no blocking error was recorded (severity "error" or "fatal"). Warnings don't fail the run.

render().Summary: MARK:-[PUBLIC]=== === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Renders the compiled template by replacing variables with values from $data.Missing keys produce an empty string.

Params: the vector being defined. Its own "<vectorName>_dirty" flag is an ERROR
validate().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Validates that all keys in the phrase can be resolved against a DataClass.Walks dot-notation paths through relations (N:1 / 1:1).Returns {success: Boolean, errors: Collection of {key, message}, warnings: Collection of {key, message}}$options (all default to False — storage kind only):.allowRelations  : Boolean — allow dot-notation paths through N:1 relations.allowCalculated : Boolean — allow calculated attributes.allowAlias      : Boolean — allow alias attributes(embedding it feeds the phrase that recomputes the vector → invalidation loop); any othervector's "_dirty" flag is a WARNING (valid but meaningless text in the phrase).$vectorName : the vector being defined. Its own "<vectorName>_dirty" flag is an ERROR

createVectorObjectIndex().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Creates the automatic (object) index of the vector field.Pointers rather than SQL, so a field name with a space is fine.

vectorDistanceIndexed().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===The vector index (cosine, dot or euclidean), used by the similarity queries.

get helptip().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Always safe to call: returns the joined error list (empty string when none).Non-blocking warnings are appended below the errors.

get warnings().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Non-blocking warnings: phrase (e.g. another vector's "_dirty" flag) + missing indexes.

vectorObjectIndexed().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===The automatic (object) index, used by the "= null" / "!= null" queries.On a vector field, ORDA "indexed" only reports this one, never a vector index.

get errors().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Concatenation of phrase + model error messages (most recent validate() pass).

hasDirtyAssociatedAttribute().Summary: MARK:- dirty attributes=== === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Also drives the read-only "dirty flag" column of the vector list (see dirtyAssociatedAttributeMark).

parsePhrase().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Validate a compiled Phrase against this item's dataclass and return styledtext (multistyle) with any attribute errors highlighted.

validate().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Re-runs phrase + model validation and refreshes _phraseErrors / _modelErrors.Also refreshes the styled phrase so the editor stays in sync.

get inputsMenu().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Gives a menu of available dataclass attributes to insert into the descriptive phrase.

get dirtyAssociatedAttributeMark().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Cell value of the "dirty flag" column: a plain ✓ (U+2713, renders on macOS and Windows), not acheckbox, which would look like a control that creates the field (use the context menu for that).

get phraseHelptip().Summary: <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <== <==Same as helptip, limited to the phrase's own errors and warnings (no model or index messages).

status().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns a read-only snapshot of the top-level run state (for status reporting).

updateDefinition().Syntax: **.updateDefinition**( *defKey* : Text; *startTime* : Text; *endTime* : Text; *status* : Text; *error* : Variant; *usage* : Object )

lastRun().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns the last completed run as { timestamp; status; error }, all in the scheduler'slocal ISO base (startTime/endTime are written in that base too). While a run is inprogress the top-level endTime is Null and the last completed run sits in "previous",so fall back to it — this is what lets the scheduler rehydrate its anchor after a restartstraight from the history, without persisting the timestamp a second time in its own field.

endFullRun().Syntax: **.endFullRun**( *startTimestamp* : Text; *endTimestamp* : Text; *status* : Text; *error* : Variant; *nextComputeDate* : Variant; *usage* : Object )

save().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Persists the edited configuration through the Scheduler, then reloads the normalized values.

onConfigEdit().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Reacts to an interval/daily/startFrom edit: clamps hours, rewrites the daily time in itscanonical "HH:MM" form (an emptied field falls back to midnight rather than stayingblank), re-syncs the stepper, and refreshes the preview.

currentConfig().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Builds a raw scheduler config object from the current form variables.

onLoad().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===On Load: register the window, load the saved config, arm a periodic status refresh.

resetAnchor().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Re-anchors the fixed-rate schedule on the current instant, and selects that mode.Like every other control in the config panel it only edits the pending configuration;Save is what commits it.

preview().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Computes and displays the next run from the *current edits* (not necessarily saved yet).

selectMode().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Shows the page of a mode ("never", "interval" or "daily"; anything else is never). Appliedat once, without waiting for the On Page Change that follows (it then finds nothing to do).

reset().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Invalidate the cache. Call with no argument to clear everything,or with a dataclass name to drop a single entry.

isExcludedStorageType().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns True when a storage attribute should be excluded from a phrase.blob and image are always excluded; object is excluded unless $allowObject is True.

isVectorDirtySibling().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns True when $fieldName is the "<vectorName>_dirty" invalidation flag of a 4D.Vectorattribute present on $dataclass (these boolean flags are never useful inside a phrase).

hasField().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns True if the given field name exists on the dataclass.Field name set is cached per dataclass so repeated lookups (typicallyfor "${vectorName}_dirty" probes during batch embedding runs) are O(1).

forDataclass().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns the collection of "supported" attributes for the given dataclass,filtered by the optional phrase options (allowRelations, allowCalculated, allowAlias, allowObject).The base list is cached per dataclass; options filtering is applied on top without caching.

waitIfNeeded().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Pre-flight throttle. Waits if the remaining budget is too low for the next batch.

slotAfter().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns the next schedule slot strictly after $after (local ISO), or "" in "never" mode.Used to detect scheduled slots that elapse while a batch is running (skip traceability).

secondsUntil().Summary: *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** ***Seconds from now until the given local ISO timestamp (may be negative if past).

Params: local ISO timestamp of the last completed run, or "" if none.
local ISO timestamp used as the "start from now" anchor (arm time), or "" for current.
nextRun().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Computes the next scheduled run.$lastExecution : local ISO timestamp of the last completed run, or "" if none.$anchor        : local ISO timestamp used as the "start from now" anchor (arm time), or "" for current.

embedBatch().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Embed a collection of texts in a single API call.Returns a EmbedderResult with vectors in same order as inputs.

embed().Summary: MARK:-[PUBLIC]=== === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Embed a single text. Returns a 4D.Vector.Throws on fatal errors after retries are exhausted.

get().Summary: *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** ***The settings content, or Null when there is none to read (absent or unreadable file).Use read() when the difference matters.

read().Summary: *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** ***Reads the settings file and tells the caller *why* there is no content, which a bareNull cannot: an absent file is a fresh install, an unreadable one is a file we must notoverwrite with defaults.Returns { exists : Boolean ; valid : Boolean ; data : Object }

meta().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Default severity ("warning" | "error" | "fatal") and retryability for a code.Callers may override these per-error, but these defaults cover the common case.

get isFatal().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===True when this error blocks the rest of the run (e.g. a model is unavailable).

processEntitySelection().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Process an entity selection. Preferred path for large jobs — honors batchSize.

processEntity().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Process a single entity. $definition rules match resolveForEntity.

process().Summary: MARK:-[PUBLIC]=== === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Process one, many, or all Definitions across their full dataclass selections.$definition may be: Null (= all definitions in settings), a single Definition,or a collection of Definition.

autoStart().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===True when the host database authorizes the component "On Host Database Event" method(Settings > Security), in which case the scheduler arms and disarms itself with the host.False means the host is responsible for calling start() and stop().

isStarted().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===True when the background loop worker is alive, i.e. the scheduler really runs.

force().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Forces a recalculation now. Honors the single-batch rule: skipped if one is running (AC-6.5).

stop().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Disarms the scheduler. The loop worker stops; a running batch keeps finishing.

config().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns the effective scheduler configuration with defaults applied.

saveConfig().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Validates and persists a scheduler configuration, then returns the normalized value.Only the "scheduler" key is written; _Settings.set merges, preserving other keys.

reload().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Config is re-read by the loop on each cycle; nothing to do beyond returning status.

cancel().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Requests a cooperative cancel of the running batch (never force-kills).

start().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Arms the scheduler: starts the background loop worker if not already running.Idempotent — calling it again just refreshes the arm-time anchor, which interval modeonly falls back to when the config carries no startReference.

resolveForProcess().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Resolution for the dataclass-wide process($definition) entry point.No entity context available.

resolveForEntity().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Resolution for processEntity*() entry points.$contextDataclassName is the dataclass inferred from the entity/selection.

confirm().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Asks $message and returns True when the user accepted.$okLabel / $cancelLabel are optional button titles.

seedStudents().Summary: Drop and re-create a deterministic fixture set: 1 city (Paris), 1 school(Sorbonne) and $count students. Returns {city; school; students}.

ensureAliases().Summary: Ensure every requested model alias exists (test-only bootstrap, mock mode).Returns True when all requested aliases resolve after the bootstrap.

itemCount().Summary: MARK:-[INFORMATIONS]=== === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Returns the number of menu items present in the menu

property().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Associates a property to a menu item⚠️ ONE CAN SET A PROPERTY FOR ALL MENU TYPE (MENU BAR OR POPUP)BUT  UNIQUELY RETRIEVE IT FOR THE MENU BAR ITEMS

line().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Adds/insert a lineIf afterItem < 0, it is considered as the offset from the item count of the menu

append().Summary: MARK:-[DEFINITION]=== === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Adds/insert an itemIf afterItem < 0, it is considered as the offset from the item count of the menu

onLoad().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===On Load: register the window, build the styled lines, fit the buttons to their captions.

assert().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Throws when 4D AIKit cannot be used. isCriticalAPIError makes cs.Process stop calling themodel for the rest of the run instead of failing once per entity.

embed().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Compute a vector for an arbitrary input — without persisting anywhere.Useful for search queries, similarity checks, or previews.Supported call shapes:embed("some text"; "text-embedding-3-small")          → direct embedembed("some text"; $definition)                        → uses $definition.modelAliasembed($entity; $definition)                            → renders definition.phrase, embeds with definition.modelAliasembed($entity; $phrase; "text-embedding-3-small")      → renders $phrase, embeds with given modelembed($entity; "template with {field}"; "model")       → compiles template on the flyembed($entity)                                         → auto-resolve definition from settings (unique match required)embed($entity; {vectorName: "v"})                      → stub → saved definition (deduces phrase + model)embed($entity; {phrase: "tpl {x}"; modelAlias: "m"})   → ad-hoc stub, phrase compiled inline, model taken from stubembed("some text"; {modelAlias: "m"})                  → stub supplies the model only$context stubs are resolved exactly like cs.Process resolves its definition argument — a{vectorName} stub is matched against the saved definitions for the (entity's) dataclass; anexplicit {modelAlias} on the stub always wins over a deduced one.Throws if no model can be determined.

render().Summary: === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === ===Render the phrase for an entity and return the resulting text. No API call, no persistence.- cs.Phrase                  → used directly- cs.Definition     → uses $definition.phrase- Text                       → compiled on the fly as a new Phrase- Object stub                → {vectorName[; dataclassName]} looked up in settings (deduces the phrase),or {phrase|template: Text} compiled inline- Null                       → auto-resolved from settings (requires a unique match for $entity's dataclass)$entity: 4D entity$definitionOrPhrase: could be
